description: Link a CRM account to a Sage customer, so the financial status can be fetched by account instead of by number. Stored in external_links (system = the Sage version), which is the same place the Odoo and tender links live — one reference model, not a new table.

customer_number.description: Customer number in Sage (Sage 100: kto; Cloud: reference or id)

label.description: What to show — usually the customer name.

version.description: Sage connector the customer belongs to

name: link_sage_customer
